profile.headline: Senior Software Development Manager of Automation at Oracle
profile.summary:
Firmware developer, Linux kernel developer and project manager in a wide variety of system applications.  Particularly interested in leadership and development of bootloaders, drivers and application infrastructures using C and assembly code.  Always interested in bring-up of new embedded products, as well as close interaction with hardware.

Specialties: Embedded hardware bringup, Linux, BIOS, bootloaders, u-boot, C, PowerPC and x86 assembly, project management tools, author functional and design specifications
